title: Stockfish, But It Loses 100 ELO If I Play The BEST Move
summary: 'Tiltfish': Stockfish starts at 3600 and loses 100 Elo every time the player plays the engine's best move. Player (white) steers into London System structures, playing Nf3/e3 when they match the engine's top choice (3500, 3400...), and tries to let the engine attack so only-moves become top moves. Rating drops too slowly (only -200 by move 6); player reaches resignable positions and is eventually mated (Kd4 forced, mate). Final review: player ~80% accuracy vs engine 94%; challenge lost.
rules: After each player move, if it matches the engine's top move, bot loses 100 Elo.
